_instructions: Copy this file, fill in the required fields, and pass it to <RUNNER>/src/waq/f_run_waq.py with --config or set CONFIG_PATH in that script.
Fields marked AUTO are read from the resolved <model>.hyd file automatically — do not add them.
The runner finds <model>.hyd from the project .mdu name and WaqOutputDir; if no .mdu is found it searches for one unique .hyd under the project.
Remove the leading underscore comment keys (_instructions, _notes) before using.
Date/time strings must be ISO format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
Hydrodynamic coupling-file paths are not needed here — they come from the HYD file.
_note_dynamic: Choose ONE model dynamic per run. Preferred form is a single dynamic field.
Use a built-in keyword such as 'oxygen-simple', or a path to an editable dynamic JSON.
When a path is used, the dynamic key is read from that JSON file.
WAQ nutrient IDs use the selected dynamic's constituent basis. External NH4/NO3/NO2 files are expected as N mass, PO4/AAP as P mass, and Si/Opal as Si mass unless the dynamic says otherwise.
Basis notation may put the element or molecule before or after the physical unit, e.g. ugN/l and ug/l N are equivalent.

_note_dynamic_options.oxygen-simple: NH4 (constituent-basis, usually gN/m3), CBOD5 (g/m3), OXY (g/m3), SOD (g/m2 passive)
_note_dynamic_options.oxygen-bod: OXY (g/m3), CBOD5 (g/m3) — simpler O2/BOD with salinity/temp
_note_dynamic_options.tracers: cTR1/cTR2/cTR3 and dTR1/dTR2/dTR3 (g/m3) — conservative and decaying tracers
_note_dynamic_options.eutrophication-duflow: A, DP, PP, NORG, NH4, NO3 (WAQ constituent basis; nutrients usually N/P mass) — simplified eutrophication (DUFLOW EUTROFIA)
_note_dynamic_options.cadmium: IM1 (g/m3), Cd (g/m3), IM1S1/CdS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.copper: IM1 (g/m3), Cu (g/m3), IM1S1/CuS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.lead: IM1 (g/m3), Pb (g/m3), IM1S1/PbS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.zinc: IM1 (g/m3), Zn (g/m3), IM1S1/ZnS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.mercury: IM1 (g/m3), Hg (g/m3), IM1S1/HgS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.nickel: IM1 (g/m3), Ni (g/m3), IM1S1/NiS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.chromium: IM1 (g/m3), Cr (g/m3), IM1S1/CrS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.arsenic: IM1 (g/m3), As (g/m3), IM1S1/AsS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.vanadium: IM1 (g/m3), Va (g/m3), IM1S1/VaS1 (g/m2 passive) — single-metal sorption, real Kd defaults
_note_dynamic_options.suspended-sediment: IM1/2/3 (g/m3) in water, IM1S1/IM2S1/IM3S1 (g/m2 passive) in bed
_note_dynamic_options.trace-metals-duflow: AS/CU/NI/PB/ZN totals plus POC/AOC/DOC/SS water and passive bed phases (DUFLOW METAL)
_note_dynamic_options.oxygen-bod-sediment: OXY, CBOD5 (g/m3), SOD (g/m2 passive) — native, from Deltares' own .sub template
_note_dynamic_options.eutrophication-dynamo-1sp: NH4/NO3 as N, PO4/AAP as P, Opal as Si where selected units are gN/gP/gSi per m3; other active substances use their dynamic units — native DYNAMO, 1 algae species
_note_dynamic_options.eutrophication-dynamo-2sp: NO3/NH4 as N, PO4/AAP as P, Si as Si where selected units are gN/gP/gSi per m3; other active substances use their dynamic units + full S1 sediment layer — native DYNAMO, 2 algae species
_note_dynamic_options.eutrophication-bloom: NH4/NO3 as N, PO4 as P, Si/Opal as Si where selected units are gN/gP/gSi per m3; POC/PON/POP/POS and algae use dynamic units — native BLOOM, no sediment
_note_dynamic_options.eutrophication-bloom-sediment: NH4/NO3 as N, PO4 as P, Si/Opal as Si where selected units are gN/gP/gSi per m3; other active substances use their dynamic units + sediment layer — native BLOOM
_note_dynamic_options.protist: Continuity/OXY plus NH4/NO3 as N, PO4 as P, Si/Opal as Si where selected units are gN/gP/gSi per m3; organic pools and algae use dynamic units + S1 sediment — richest single-species native template

_note_folderName: Name used for output files: output/WAQ/<folderName>_his.nc, _map.nc
_note_times: Simulation period.  Must fall within the hydrodynamic simulation period.
_note_refDate: Optional fallback for HYD-only WAQ runs where no .mdu is supplied.
Use the MDU RefDate format, e.g. 20240207 or '2024-02-07 00:00:00'.
When an .mdu is supplied, its RefDate is authoritative and this value is ignored.
_note_timeFormat: DELWAQ duration rendering format for timestep fields; JSON timestep values remain seconds. DDHHMMSS matches the bundled INP template.
_note_timeStep1: DELWAQ calculation timestep in seconds. Optional override.
Defaults to the hydrodynamic coupling timestep from the .hyd file when omitted.
Set this explicitly to a smaller value than the HYD timestep for conditionally-stable
integration schemes (e.g. 5, 12) that need a finer step than a coarse hydrodynamic
coupling interval allows. Must evenly divide the HYD timestep.
_note_outputTimeSteps: historyTimeStep controls history/time-series output at obsPoints/obsFiles.
mapTimeStep controls full-grid map output; this is often coarser because *_map.nc files can become large.
Both must be even multiples of the hydrodynamic coupling timestep.
_note_timeStep2: Legacy fallback for older configs. If historyTimeStep/mapTimeStep are omitted, both use timeStep2; new configs should leave this null.
_note_outputFormats: Controls DELWAQ Block 9 history/map file switches.
Preferred/default for this project is NetCDF history/map output, because g_waq_post.py parses *_his.nc and *_map.nc.
binaryHistory/binaryMap request DELWAQ native binary .his/.map files as backup/diagnostic outputs.
netcdfHistory/netcdfMap request NEFIS/NetCDF output; with UGRID geometry this is written as NetCDF.
These switches do not control WAQ final-state restart artifacts such as *_res.map or .res.
_note_balanceOutput: Preferred/default is enabled and detailed so g_waq_post.py --plot-balance has balance terms available.
enabled:  true/false - turn mass-balance output on/off.
detailed: true/false - if true, report each boundary/load/transport term separately
instead of lumped totals (DELWAQ BAL_NOLUMP* keywords).
timeStep: balance-output interval in seconds. Omit/null to match mapTimeStep.
_note_solver: scheme: DELWAQ integration option, '<base scheme>.<sub-option digits>'.
Valid base scheme numbers: 1-5, 10-16, 19-24 (0 and 6-9/17-18 are invalid).
15 (default) - implicit upwind, iterative solver: unconditionally stable,
works for any timestep/unstructured grid. DELWAQ's own 'safe' choice.
16 - as 15 but central vertical discretisation; better for stratified/pycnocline
12 - horizontal explicit + vertical implicit, more accurate, but only
conditionally stable: requires a small enough timeStep1.
The optional sub-option digits after the decimal point set legacy
maxiter:   GMRES solver maximum iterations.  Increase if you get 'ERROR in GMRES'.
tolerance: GMRES convergence tolerance.  Tighten (smaller) for more accurate results.
_note_obsOutputLayers: History output layer selection for 3-D WAQ runs.
"all" writes one monitoring station per vertical layer at each obsPoints/obsFiles location.
"single" keeps the legacy one-segment monitoring output.
_note_obsPoints: Can be used alongside obsFiles. Leave empty [] if no inline monitoring points are needed.
_note_obsFiles: Optional external-file form for history-output monitoring locations.
Each item points to a PLI or XYN file in the model's native grid coordinates.
PLI: each feature must contain exactly one point; the feature name becomes the monitoring point name.
XYN: each row is x y name, matching the hydro ObsFile format; the row name becomes the monitoring point name.
A name field may be supplied only for a single-point file to override the file's point name.
Relative file paths are resolved relative to this JSON config file.
_note_loadsData: Leave empty [] if there are no point sources.
The name must be unique and ≤20 characters (DELWAQ load-ID limit).
_note_loadsTimeSeries: Time-varying concentrations and flow for each point source in loadsData.
Omit or set to null if loadsData is empty.
Mapping rule: rows[*].values[i] belongs to loadsData[i]. For example,
values[0] is the first load in loadsData, values[1] is the second load, etc.
substances: list of DELWAQ substance IDs to specify. FLOW (m3/s) must come first
if you want to set the discharge flow rate. All other substances must already use
the selected WAQ constituent basis. Common nutrients: NH4/NO3/NO2 as gN/m3,
PO4/AAP as gP/m3, and Si/Opal as gSi/m3 where those units are used.
DELWAQ reads these numbers directly; it does not convert molecular mass.
rows:       list of timesteps in strictly ascending order.
values:   one sub-array per load, positionally matched to loadsData.
each sub-array has one value per substance in the same order as "substances".
TIME LINEAR DATA interpolation is used between rows (linear, not step-function).

_note_loadsFiles: Optional external-file form for large point-source load time series.
Use this instead of, or alongside, loadsData/loadsTimeSeries when source flows have many timesteps.
Each item is one WAQ load. The PLI must contain exactly one point.
The TIM columns must be: time_minutes_since_MDU_RefDate, then one column per substance.
FLOW (m3/s) must be first when present. Other substances are concentrations in the selected WAQ constituent basis.
For common nutrient dynamics this means NH4/NO3/NO2 as N mass, PO4/AAP as P mass, and Si/Opal as Si mass where those units are used.
DELWAQ reads TIM load values directly; external files should already be basis-correct before TIM generation.
The item name is the authoritative WAQ load ID and must be unique across loadsData and loadsFiles.
Relative file paths are resolved relative to this JSON config file.
Use <RUNNER>/src/utils/waq/build_waq_load_tim.py to create these TIM files from hydrodynamic source TIM files.
Use e_check_waq_inputs.py --config <this file> --plot-timeseries to visually inspect WAQ load series.
_note_initialConditions: Initial concentrations for every substance in the selected dynamic are required.
Preferred form: initialConditions object keyed by substance ID.
Uniform form: either a number such as 8.0 or an object such as {"type": "uniform", "value": 0.1}.
Depths are metres positive downward and values are linearly interpolated/extrapolated
to layer-center depths auto-derived from the HYD/MDU geometry, then repeated horizontally for each model layer.
Set initialLayerDepths to "auto" or omit it for normal use; provide a numeric list only as an override.
Use <RUNNER>/src/utils/waq/profiler_do_initial_conditions.py to convert profiler DO percent saturation
in sensorParms(6), with temperature from sensorParms(1), into an OXY depthProfile in g/m3.
Field values must contain one numeric value per WAQ segment.
Active substances use the selected WAQ constituent basis. Common nutrients: NH4/NO3/NO2 as gN/m3, PO4/AAP as gP/m3, and Si/Opal as gSi/m3 where those units are used.
Passive bed substances use the selected dynamic's bed unit, usually g/m2.
DELWAQ reads initial-condition numbers directly; external field/profile files should already be basis-correct.
Relative field3d file paths are resolved relative to this JSON config file.
Legacy useforsFrom + multiline initial is still accepted, but it must also cover every dynamic substance.
_note_initialConditionsSource: Optional alternative to initialConditions for spin-up/follow-on workflows.
Set to {"type": "delwaqRestartMap", "file": "../../../output/WAQ/previous_run_res.map"} to initialize from an existing DELWAQ native final-state restart artifact.
The file must already exist from a previous WAQ run. D3DFMRunner does not configure when DELWAQ emits *_res.map/.res restart artifacts.
This uses DELWAQ Block 8 binary restart input and supports only native *_res.map/.res artifacts, not NetCDF *_map.nc.
When initialConditionsSource is set, remove or set initialConditions to null, keep useforsFrom empty, and keep initial empty.
Relative file paths are resolved relative to this JSON config file.
_note_legacy_initial: Legacy uniform-only syntax retained for old configs:
useforsFrom: list of substance IDs receiving initial conditions.
initial: one substance per line as '<SubstanceName> <value>'.
Substances no longer default silently to 0; preflight errors if any dynamic substance is missing.
